review.identity: bunny-alpha-2 (implementer run; no independent review yet)
review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with `retail` (CS_GAME_DIR) and this task's own windowed run executed on this machine's GPU (`gpu`) with the machine's audio backend (`audio`): the harness ran `cs --cs-path $CS_GAME_DIR --mission M01` with CS_MISSION_CAPTURE=1 and the derived scenario (exit 0), which opened a real window, drew the original M01 world with the renderer, and delivered framebuffer PNGs, the run trace and the launch sound's own source-boundary playback record. Every field in this report is derived from the recorded log, production discovery of $CS_GAME_DIR, and that run's own trace.jsonl and playback.json. MEASURED: the anchor [-5972.0, 1460.0, -7680.0] and the measured start are read from the live composition (stage_for + a headless composition of the same records the windowed run loads); the placement is the measured start's altitude 1318 m and 1300 m from the anchor along the line toward the measured start, heading at it; the block index 2 and its record's effect lists (NAP 4, WAKE 27/51, KILL 41/48) come from the recovered engine model. The trigger completed on tick 802 (frame 735): the observed player row was 699.4 m from the observed anchor row (radius 700 m) and the effect states were ["nap 3 Napping", "wake 26 Awake", "wake 50 Awake", "kill 40 null", "kill 47 null"]; the framebuffer PNG of that frame is an artifact. DESIGNED: the placement itself is a test placement, never the measured start, and is listed under overrides; which pose source an observer reads is this reimplementation's own contract. The placement is derived from the live composition: the anchor sits at [-5972.0, 1460.0, -7680.0], the measured start at [-3694.0, 1318.0, -12482.0] (heading 2.9671 rad) 5317 m away; the run starts 1307.7 m from the anchor on that line, at the measured start's own altitude, heading at the anchor. LIMITS: no original executable ran, so nothing here is verified_original; the flight law is the statically recovered fixed-wing law, still uncalibrated against an original run (#358); the windowed criterion this task carries is met by the run recorded here and by no claim about how the original behaved. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass.
